name: Meson Finance
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: The Twitter account of the cross-chain bridge Meson Finance posted a tweet containing a phishing link. Meson Finance tweeted that the relevant content has been deleted and confirmed that the issue originated from a third-party API rather than a direct attack on the account.
